name: After § 4
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 4b. Condemns in the strongest possible terms Russia’s continuing hybrid war against Europe, including sabotage of critical infrastructure, cyberattacks, espionage, FIMI, covert financing and corruption, election interference, the recruitment of proxies and saboteurs, transnational repression, intimidation of European citizens and public officials, and the abuse of international legal and law-enforcement instruments for political purposes; stresses that these activities constitute elements of a coordinated strategy aimed at weakening European states, dividing their societies, undermining democratic institutions and reducing their capacity to resist Russian aggression; calls for a substantially stronger policy of deterrence;
